mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) indicate robust residential construction activity, signaling strong consumer demand and economic expansion that typically boosts corporate revenues and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when HOUST exceeds its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent inflation above 3.5% annualized (CPIAUCSL) signals the Federal Reserve will initiate monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate and federal funds rate indicate active monetary easing in response to labor market weakness, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls > 0.2pp and FEDFUNDS falls > 0.1pp in 1 month
regime_hint: labor market deterioration with policy response
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both UNRATE and FEDFUNDS decline as specified.

mechanism_narrative: Low industrial production growth (INDPRO) indicates supply chain constraints and reduced manufacturing output, leading to lower corporate profits and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days in a supply-constrained regime.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: Rising retail sales (RSAFS) reflect strong consumer spending, directly supporting corporate revenue growth and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market sentiment improves.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when RSAFS exceeds its 3-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% signals economic weakness and reduced consumer spending, leading to lower corporate earnings expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPI inflation and federal funds rate indicate aggressive monetary tightening to combat inflation, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL rises > 0.3pp and FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS rise as specified.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth below 1.0% annualized signals an economic slowdown, reducing corporate earnings expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of quarters when GDPC1 growth is below 1.0%.
